decisions.reason: The expanded handoff assets support future independent editing but do not change the existing set of customer-specific fields or their editing behavior.
Providing additional design assets does not change the scoring table's presentation, fields, or purpose.
The same source independently establishes the Canva-template Requirement, while the asset-handoff change does not alter its format, editability, variants, or scope.
The same source independently establishes the PDF-export Requirement, but the expanded asset handoff does not change the required PDF format, final-export state, or report variants.
The handoff assets and independent-editing purpose do not change the front-page explanation's content, format, or detail level.
The asset-handoff expansion does not change the four report variants, their identifiers, selection basis, or exposure-level mapping.
Supplying fonts, icons, logos, colour codes, and other assets enables later editing but does not modify the established visual-design standard or design direction.
The expanded asset package does not alter the dashboard's displayed fields, prominence, heading, visibility, or visual reference.
The asset-handoff change does not alter the internal header's coverage, style, or required information.
The asset-handoff change does not alter footer coverage, consistency, style, or displayed information.
The additional handoff assets do not change the inclusion, ranking, priority tiers, or action-focused presentation of security recommendations.
Message 74 requests Canva templates and PDF exports in addition to the already delivered Word documents; it does not remove or modify any Word-template requirement state.
